Class BinarySearchTree<T extends Comparable<? super T>>

java.lang.Object
assignments.datastructures.BinarySearchTree<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the type of comparable elements stored in the tree
All Implemented Interfaces:
adt.Tree<T>, Iterable<T>
public class BinarySearchTree<T extends Comparable<? super T>> extends Object implements adt.Tree<T>
An unbalanced binary search tree that stores distinct, comparable values. Each node's left subtree contains smaller values, and its right subtree contains larger values. Values that compare as equal are not duplicated.

The tree uses the natural ordering defined by Comparable. Search, insertion, and removal take O(h) time, where h is the tree's height: typically O(log n) for a reasonably shaped tree but O(n) in the worst case. Traversal iterators contain a snapshot of the values when requested. Null values are not supported.
